notes: politics-debug-scrutiny.json is a compact direct-scrutiny bridge derived from the R golden fixture.
politics-pipeline-source-debug.json is a compact real-source generation bridge derived from dati/debug_scrutinio.RData.
politics-static-debug.json is a production-shaped bridge snapshot split into reusable data and a default scenario; it is still derived from the debug source.
politics-static.json is exported from the current R politics preparation pipeline using dati/dati.RData and scenari/politiche_2027.xlsx.
The worker currently prefers politics-static.json and falls back to politics-static-debug.json if the production bridge snapshot is absent.
regional-er-static.json is exported from the current R Emilia-Romagna regional preparation pipeline using dati/dati.RData and scenari/BO_insieme.xlsx.
